name: Evolve CIMA road
why_interesting: Repeatedly featured in ChineseCarbon top posts; a distinct road frameset, not the existing CIMA GR.

facts.frame_weight_basis: Manufacturer: size M, unpainted frame only
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Manufacturer lists 700C tires from 24C to 32C; verify measured tire/rim fit
facts.sizes: XS, S, M, ML, L, XL
facts.frame: Electronic shifting only; Shimano/SRAM electronic and Campagnolo WRL listed, EPS excluded
facts.included_package: Frame, fork and seatpost; bottle cages and bar tape are excluded unless separately purchased. Kreuza Apex integrated handlebar is optional. Confirm other hardware and selected finish.
facts.international_price_reference: US$2,299 for Navy White; optional handlebar bundle addition US$200, observed 2026-09-22. This is not a mainland delivered CNY quote.
facts.warranty: Current Evolve policy: lifetime frame/fork coverage for the first owner; two years for seatpost and KREUZA handlebar, subject to stated conditions and exclusions. Confirm eligibility for the exact purchase channel.
facts.stiffness_evidence: Cyclists Hub subjectively describes the CIMA as stiffer than a Winspace SLC5, especially out of the saddle/under acceleration. The reviewer discloses a manufacturer-supplied frame and handlebar. No instrumented whole-frame stiffness result was published.

official_price.price_basis: Exact official Evolve CIMA Navy White frame, fork and seatpost package at US$2,299 converted using the ECB reference cross-rate; optional US$200 cockpit bundle is excluded.
official_price.conditions: Foreign reference only; selected finish/stock, mainland price, shipping, tax, duties and actual transaction rate are unverified.

missing: Final delivered amount after shipping/checkout and selected-size stock remain unverified; the CNY 14,800 listing is for the CIMA Artist – Wilderness frameset, with optional Kreuza integrated handlebar extra.
Current local warranty claim handling for the selected purchase route remains unverified.
source_note:
Official Navy White page lists USD 2,299 on 2026-09-05, excluding optional cockpit. This is not a China price or complete-bike total.

Batch 35 recheck: the exact CIMA review sample is manufacturer-supplied. The review's stiffness comparison is subjective and uninstrumented; it also confirms bottle cages and bar tape are extra. Current warranty policy describes lifetime frame/fork coverage for the first owner and two years for the seatpost and KREUZA handlebar, subject to policy conditions; verify the transaction channel and exclusions.

Batch 52 mainland price (2026-09-24): official Evolve China product page lists CIMA Artist – Wilderness at CNY 14,800, including frame, fork, seatpost and essential parts, with the integrated Kreuza handlebar optional. The core frame specification matches this candidate; the named finish differs from the global CIMA Speed Navy White reference. Shipping, checkout amount and selected-size stock remain unverified.

observed_price.price_basis: CIMA Artist – Wilderness frameset listing; includes frame, fork, seatpost and essential parts; optional Kreuza integrated handlebar is extra
observed_price.conditions: Shipping, selected-size stock and final checkout amount were not displayed or verified.
